desc: Implement and sample-test the min-heap grid expansion solution with `O(HW log(HW))` complexity.
Derive the greedy invariant: if the minimum frontier strength is ineligible then all frontier cells are, while absorbing any eligible cell only increases strength and expands available options.
Design frontier maintenance with queued/visited tracking, four-direction traversal, and a min-heap.
Check arithmetic safety: Python arbitrary-precision integers safely handle cumulative strengths and `candidate * X`.
Review edge cases in the implemented code: `X = 1`, initially blocked frontier, one-cell grid, duplicate discovery, and strict inequality.
